title: RuPay Credit Card on UPI: How It Works, Charges and Best Cards
summary: RuPay credit card on UPI explained: how to link it to GPay, PhonePe or Paytm, charges, limits, what you can and cannot pay, and the best RuPay cards for 2026.
body_markdown:
A RuPay credit card can be linked to UPI apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm and BHIM, so you can scan any shop's QR code and pay from your credit limit instead of your bank balance. You pay no extra fee for this, you still get the interest-free period, and only RuPay credit cards work. Visa and Mastercard credit cards cannot be linked to UPI.


Below are the 6 best RuPay credit cards for UPI in India, what each one offers, and the steps to get one. All six are live on the GroMo app today. Want a no-fee card? Our guide on[lifetime free credit cards](https://gromo.in/blog/lifetime-free-credit-card/) explains how those work.

2. Complete KYC with PAN and Aadhaar.
3. Get your virtual RuPay card after approval.
4. Link it to your UPI app and start scanning.

## How Does a RuPay Credit Card on UPI Work?


A RuPay credit card on UPI is your normal RuPay card added as a payment source inside a UPI app. When you scan a merchant QR code, you choose the credit card instead of your bank account, enter your UPI PIN, and the amount goes on your card bill. RuPay is run by NPCI, the same body that runs UPI, which is why only RuPay cards can be connected.


### Which credit cards can you link to UPI?


Only RuPay credit cards can be linked to UPI. Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Diners cards cannot. Check the logo on your card: if it says RuPay, you can link it.


### How to link a RuPay credit card to Google Pay, PhonePe or Paytm


The steps are almost the same in every UPI app.


1. Open your UPI app and go to payment methods.
2. Tap **Add RuPay credit card** .
3. Select your card issuer.
4. The app finds the card linked to your registered mobile number.
5. Enter the last 6 digits of the card and the expiry date.
6. Enter the OTP from your card issuer.
7. Set a new UPI PIN for this card.


Your UPI mobile number must match the one registered with your card. If the app cannot find the card, update your number with the issuer first.


### Credit card UPI payment charges


You do not pay any extra fee for paying a merchant with a RuPay credit card on UPI. Any processing fee, called MDR, is the merchant's cost, and small merchants are not charged on small payments.


Item What to know


Fee for you None for merchant payments


Interest Only if you do not pay the full bill by the due date


Late payment fee Same as any card payment


Rewards Set by your issuer, some give less or none on certain UPI categories


### What you can and cannot pay with a credit card on UPI


You can pay shops, kirana stores, restaurants and online checkouts that accept UPI. You cannot send money to friends or family, withdraw cash or move money to your bank account. Normal UPI limits apply, and your card issuer may set its own daily UPI limit.

## Important Safety Tips


- **Never share your UPI PIN or OTP:** not even with callers who say they are from your bank.
- **No PIN to receive money:** a request asking for your PIN to "receive a refund" is a scam.
- **Check the merchant name:** read the name on screen before entering your PIN.
- **Pay the full bill:** UPI makes spending easy, and card interest is high if you carry a balance.
- **Turn on alerts:** switch on transaction alerts and set a daily UPI limit in your issuer's app.

## FAQ: RuPay Credit Card on UPI


### Can I link my credit card to UPI?


Yes, if it is a RuPay credit card. Visa, Mastercard and other network cards cannot be linked to UPI.


### Is there any charge for paying by credit card on UPI?


No extra charge for you on merchant payments. Interest and late fees apply only if you do not pay your card bill on time.


### Can I send money to a friend using a RuPay credit card on UPI?


No. RuPay credit cards on UPI can pay merchants only. Person-to-person transfers are not allowed.


### Which UPI apps support RuPay credit cards?


Most large UPI apps, including Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm and BHIM, plus many bank apps. Some fintech cards like Kiwi have their own app as well.


### Do I get reward points on UPI credit card payments?


Rewards depend on your card. Many cards give rewards on UPI spends, but some exclude certain categories. Check your card's reward terms.


### Is a RuPay credit card on UPI safe?


Yes, if you protect your UPI PIN. Every payment needs your PIN, and you never need a PIN to receive money.


### Can I withdraw cash using a credit card on UPI?


No. Cash withdrawal and transfers to a bank account are not allowed through UPI on a credit card.
